platform_rules.title: Platform Rules
platform_rules.description: Configuration controls reserved for upcoming platform rules. These values are stored now and are not active in current workflows.

strong_match_threshold.label: Strong match threshold
strong_match_threshold.description: Number of Full + Partial matches required for a Pit Call to reach STRONG Match Potential.

professional_relevance_threshold.label: Professional Relevance Threshold
professional_relevance_threshold.description: Minimum professional score PITCALL uses to consider a Match relevant for selected proactive and commercial rules. This does not affect Match visibility.

max_modify_per_pitcall.label: Maximum modifies per Pit Call
max_modify_per_pitcall.description: Maximum number of request edits permitted per Pit Call.

daily_recheck_budget.label: Team rolling 24h recheck budget

red_cancel_budget_cost.label: RED cancel budget cost
red_cancel_budget_cost.description: Recheck-budget units consumed by an eligible RED cancellation.

post_review_window_minutes.label: Post review window
post_review_window_minutes.description: Time available to review Match Potential immediately after posting.

team_match_update_notification_hours.label: Team match update aggregation interval
team_match_update_notification_hours.description: Aggregation interval for non-milestone Team match updates.

availability_recompute_delay_minutes.label: Availability recompute delay
availability_recompute_delay_minutes.description: Delay after the last calendar edit before deferred matching recomputation.
